title: Dedicated capacity visual playbook for first-run onboarding
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Create a compact, reusable visual playbook and set of screenshots for the Dedicated onboarding experience. Focus areas: capacity setup wizard, autoscaling controls explainer, SLA overview card, and a short checklist for first-run validation. Deliverables must include pixel-perfect mockups, export-ready assets (SVG/PNG), and annotated copy for engineering handoff. The playbook will be used in the quickstart, docs, and in-app guided tour.
tasks: Audit existing art assets and notes from DES-4021 / DES-9274 to avoid duplication
Design hero illustration for 'Reserve capacity' step that communicates predictability and isolation
Build step-by-step wizard screens: region selection, instance sizing, autoscale policy preview, cost estimate
Create microcopy variants for capacity states: provisioning, ready, degraded, backfilled
Visual explainers for autoscale knobs (min/max/target utilization) with a timeline micro-graph
Design SLA summary card and failure/fallback visual states
Capture high-fidelity screenshots from prototype and prepare responsive slices (desktop/tablet/phone)
Annotate accessibility tokens, color contrast, and focus states for QA
Prepare export package: SVGs, 1x/2x PNGs, source Figma file, and engineering spec doc
acceptance_criteria: Figma playbook file with organized pages and component variants
Export-ready assets in Drive folder with naming convention: playbook-hero.svg, wizard-step-01.png, autoscale-explainer.svg, sla-card.png
Design review approval from PM (Priya Kapoor) and Engineering lead (Jin Park)
Inline microcopy and localization notes included in Confluence doc
Prototype tested at 3 breakpoints and screenshots taken for quickstart docs
Engineering handoff ticket with annotated specs and PR reference
